Subject: Follow-up: Deployment mode & HIPAA/SOC2 evidence for Acme Health

Hi Alicia --

Great to meet today -- thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the procurement path.

Call recap / recommended deployment options
- Primary requirement we heard: handling PHI under HIPAA and needing a signed BAA + SOC2 evidence.
- Options we discussed: Hosted API (fastest time-to-value), Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool + data isolation), Private (VPC / on-prem for strict regulatory requirements).
- Recommendation: start with Dedicated for predictable throughput and easier contractual alignment (we can sign a BAA and provide SOC2 Type II evidence). Private VPC is an option if you require customer-managed networking or on-prem constraints.

Security/compliance artifacts we can provide (attached):
- SOC2 Type II report (SOC2-report.pdf)
- Draft BAA (BAA-draft.docx)
- Architecture diagram, encryption & KMS notes, audit log retention details (we can share a short pack on the security call)

Questions / open items from your team
- Do you have a procurement contact and target signing date?
- Any additional controls required (HSM/KMS BYOK, specific retention windows, external audit reports)?

Proposed next steps
1) I shared SOC2-report.pdf and BAA-draft.docx on this thread. Please have your security/procurement review and flag must-haves.
2) Schedule a 30-45 min security deep-dive with our security engineering (we can cover encryption, audit logs, access controls, and deployment differences).
3) If procurement wants numbers, I can follow up with a Dedicated vs Hosted cost delta and example SOW/commit profile.

Would you be available for a security call the week of Aug 2? I can loop in Dylan and Rishi from our security/solutions team.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Marissa --

Thoughts / suggested answers for Alicia's questions (can paste into reply):

- Hosted API + BAA: Hosted API is generally available for PHI under a BAA but with caveats -- because it's a multi-tenant hosted environment we limit certain guarantees around customer-managed keys and network isolation. If Acme needs BYOK/HSM or strict VPC peering, recommend Dedicated or Private.
- Dedicated vs Hosted SLA: Hosted (standard) offers 99.9% availability SLAs for the API; Dedicated can be offered with higher uptime SLAs on contract (we should confirm exact SLA tier with contracts).
- SOC2: we have a current SOC2 Type II report attached (SOC2-report.pdf). Confirm whether they need the full control matrix or just the auditor letter.
- Questionnaire: I'm happy to own the security questionnaire -- I can either fill the form or hop on the call to walk the security team through answers.

Suggested call times (PST): Tue Aug 3 10:00-10:45, Wed Aug 4 09:00-09:45.

I'll also prepare a short slide with architecture options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and the specific tradeoffs for PHI.

Thanks,
Dylan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
